proposals.title: Equal Voting Rights for Each Share
proposals.topic_summary: Asks the Board to ensure all outstanding stock has one vote per share, encouraging dual-class holders to relinquish preexisting super-voting rights.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal 4 because it is not in the best interests of Ford and you.

proposals.title: Lobbying disclosure report
proposals.proponent: The Comptroller of the City of New York on behalf of various City employee retirement systems; Unitarian Universalist Association
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annually updated report disclosing Ford's direct and indirect lobbying policies, payments, grassroots communications, and oversight processes.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST Proposal 5 because it is not in the best interests of Ford and you.
